description: Port the Claude task loop to Pi and loaded Tiiny models.

userStories.title: Add the Tiiny runner command line and preflight
userStories.description: As a user, I want familiar arguments so I can run Ralph on Tiiny.
acceptanceCriteria: Create executable ./ralph_tiiny.sh; leave ralph_claude.sh intact.
Keep all new or modified lines shorter than 80 columns.
Accept --model MODEL_ID and its equivalent alias -m MODEL_ID.
Keep MAX_ITERATIONS and MAX_TURNS_PER_SESSION positional args.
Default iteration and session-turn limits to 10 and 80.
Accept model flags before or after the positional arguments.
Reject unknown flags, missing values, and extra positional args.
Reject nonpositive or noninteger limits with a usage error.
Provide --help describing defaults and loaded-model selection.
Require pi, tiiny, jq, Git, and a working Git repository.
Use cwd-relative PROMPT.md, specs/prd.json, and progress.log.
Fail clearly for missing prompt or PRD; create progress.log.
Add offline CLI tests using stub commands and temporary repos.
For shell-only changes, record typecheck as N/A; run bash -n.
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: 57 offline CLI cases pass; bash -n and ShellCheck pass.

userStories.title: Choose and announce an already loaded Tiiny model
userStories.description: As a user, I want loaded-model discovery to avoid wrong-model runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Query Tiiny's loaded-model list before starting any Pi session.
Use the supported Tiiny CLI/API and verify its response schema.
Do not infer loaded state from installed or downloaded models.
Without a model flag, select the sole loaded model automatically.
With multiple models, exit nonzero before running Pi.
That error lists loaded IDs and requests --model or -m MODEL_ID.
An explicit model must exactly match a currently loaded model ID.
An explicit ID may select one model from multiple loaded models.
Zero loaded models is an actionable error, even with a model flag.
Discovery failure or malformed output is an error, not zero models.
Print the selected model's name and ID before work starts.
Do not default to Ornith or any other fixed model ID.
ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-Turbo works when loaded and selected.
Verify discovery and inference target the same Tiiny device.
Fail clearly if endpoint alignment cannot be established.
Do not connect, scan, download, load, or unload device models.
Test zero, one, many, explicit, unloaded, and discovery failures.
Keep fixtures faithful to verified Tiiny response schemas.
For shell-only changes, record typecheck as N/A; run bash -n.
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: 63 offline discovery cases pass; bash -n and ShellCheck pass.

userStories.title: Add temporary Pi model registration and a hard turn cap
userStories.description: As a user, I want Pi to use my loaded model within session limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a temporary Pi extension and load it for each session.
Register the selected model in memory before model resolution.
Reuse configured metadata for known Pi models when applicable.
Support loaded IDs absent from Pi's persistent model registry.
Discover missing metadata; document any necessary safe defaults.
Never copy unrelated model metadata via Pi's custom-ID fallback.
Use the selected Tiiny endpoint and existing auth configuration.
Do not edit persistent Pi config, Tiiny config, or host mappings.
Never print credentials or put them in diagnostics or raw logs.
Enforce MAX_TURNS_PER_SESSION through Pi events and ctx.abort().
Count model turns consistently; tool events do not add turns.
Reset the turn counter for every fresh Pi session.
Record when the cap ends a session for later failure handling.
Enable thinking for reasoning models throughout all sessions.
Do not claim medium/high/max changes Tiiny's thinking budget.
Clean up generated extension files on exit and interruption.
Test model registration, turn boundaries, reset, and cleanup.
Typecheck the generated extension against the installed Pi API.
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Temporary Tiiny provider extension and per-session turn cap added; shell validation passes.

userStories.title: Port task selection and per-session context to Pi
userStories.description: As a user, I want each Pi session to work on exactly one PRD story.
acceptanceCriteria: Use ralph_claude.sh as the reference for task-loop semantics.
Validate the PRD and its userStories array before each iteration.
Malformed or missing PRD data exits 3 rather than reporting done.
Pending stories have passes false or null, including absent flags.
Select lowest numeric priority; missing priority sorts as 9999.
Exit 0 without a Pi session when no stories remain pending.
Include PROMPT.md, chosen story, remaining stories, and log tail.
Include exactly the last eight progress.log lines as recent context.
Require one story, progress/PRD updates, a commit, and then stop.
Keep the Claude runner's stall-based reasoning_hint instructions.
Start a fresh Pi process/session for every loop iteration.
Run Pi noninteractively in JSON mode on the chosen Tiiny model.
Pass the built context as prompt input; never resume old sessions.
Capture raw JSONL before rendering it, as the Claude runner does.
Test priority, missing flags, invalid PRDs, context, and sessions.
For shell-only changes, record typecheck as N/A; run bash -n.

Treat missing or malformed terminal output as failure.
Recognize <promise>COMPLETE</promise> only in assistant text.
Require zero pending PRD stories before trusting COMPLETE.
Test success, recovered retries, errors, aborts, and bad output.
Test false COMPLETE signals while unfinished stories remain.

acceptanceCriteria: Track HEAD and pending-story count before and after each session.

Three consecutive failed sessions stop with exit 4.
A successful Pi session resets the consecutive-failure counter.
Warn when a session completes more than one pending story.
Preserve exit 0 on full completion and iteration exhaustion.
Ctrl-C exits 130; terminate active children and clean temp files.
Clean context, raw capture, and extension files on all exit paths.
Use offline stub sessions and temporary Git repos for loop tests.
